prompt:
You are reviewing an anonymous audiovisual EVENT DETECTOR X for a USER-REQUESTED COARSE PRELIMINARY estimate. The provided VIDEO INCLUDES ACTUAL ORIGINAL AUDIO, unchanged. First image identifies one physical target: 下方盛有食物的黑色平底锅本体, reference instant 36.0s. Full video length 64.12s. Track this physical instance, not all objects of its type. Green FRICTION and orange IMPACT banners appear only while X's respective prediction is ACTIVE; blank banner means no active prediction. Event numbers in the banner correspond to chronological input event entries. An event can be very short. Do not derive quality from code, complexity or a desired score. The marked reference instant is identity only.
Detect only actually audible impact or friction in which the marked physical target directly participates. An impact is a tap/knock/collision/clatter; friction is audible rubbing/scraping/sliding/brushing contact. Integrated handle/base belongs to target, loose tools, food, water, nested objects and a different object do not. Mere visible motion is not a sound. A stationary target can be struck; both contacting bodies count when directly involved. Pure pouring/splashing/food mixing/microphone rustle/voice is neither class. Track the SAME instance across time; reference instant is only identity, not an event annotation. Group same-class bursts separated by less than 0.40s; separate when gap >=0.40s. Start at audible onset and end at audible cessation including clear decay. Do not invent brief impacts from motion or all audio peaks. Unresolvable source attribution or masked texture must be marked uncertain, not silently called absent.
IMPORTANT QUALIFICATION LIMIT: this judge route distinguished silent,3-tone,5-tone inputs but failed a coarse onset timestamp control; precise time estimates and +/-80ms boundary grades are NOT qualified. Therefore DO NOT supply exact timestamps, measured TP/FP/FN or a strict F1/official total. Use source-position descriptions (beginning/middle/end and visible action) and visible banner event number to cite evidence; do not simulate listening. Evaluate marker-to-sound correspondence coarsely only. If sound or picture is unavailable, say so with null ratings.
For EACH class assess approximate precision P (fraction of triggers actually belonging to target in this class) and recall R (fraction of audible target class episodes covered by triggers) on discrete SCALE 0,1,2,3,4: 0 absent/almost all wrong,1 few correct/majority missing,2 roughly half,3 most correct with clear defects,4 all or almost all observably correct. These are coarse ordinal ESTIMATES, not event counts. For no class predictions P=null. If no audible target positive for a class, set has_target_positives=false and R=null; if audible positives exist but no trigger, R=0. Don't grant a zero-output target full recall merely because no banner appears.
For TWO difficult negative groups, other_object_sound and silent_target_action, state whether such opportunities are actually observed and rate suppression 0..4 only if observed. A motionless silent target is NOT silent_target_action. Negative quality 4 means no observed mis-triggers,0 most opportunities triggered incorrectly. Water-only sounds are not automatically either class. Coarse boundary 0..4 is only obvious continuity: cutoffs/very long tails/gaps, not exact80ms accuracy, and null when no supported target match.
Return COMPACT Chinese JSON only, no overall numeric total:

classes.audible_evidence: 视频中有多次清晰的敲击声，但均来源于勺子刮擦或敲击上方的不锈钢容器，而非下方的目标黑色平底锅。
classes.visual_evidence: 在所有IMPACT事件（如Event 1至7）发生时，画面显示操作者正用勺子在上方倾斜的不锈钢锅中进行刮取和敲击，目标黑色平底锅静止在下方且未受到任何物体的直接撞击。

clear_candidate_errors.position_and_action: 视频前段，用勺子敲击/刮擦上方不锈钢锅

negative_groups.evidence: 视频中充满了勺子与上方不锈钢锅的碰撞和刮擦声，这些声音被系统错误地标记为对下方黑色平底锅的冲击（IMPACT），未能有效抑制非目标对象的干扰。
目标平底锅全程静置，仅作为接收酱汁的容器，未发生移动、旋转等可能产生自身声响的动作。

judgment.coarse_boundary_evidence: 由于所有预测均为错误的对象归因（False Positives），不存在正确的匹配片段来评估边界质量。
limitations: 本评估基于视觉证据判断声源归属，虽然视觉上明显是敲击上方容器，但理论上不能完全排除极微弱的传导震动声，不过对于常规检测而言应视为误报。
